attempted_claim: Do there exist absolute constants c_0,C>0 such that, for every odd prime power q=p^n with n>1, every set A⊆𝔽_q^× satisfying |A|≤c_0 q^{1/2} and |A∩(aG+b)|≤|G|^{1/2} for every proper subfield G<𝔽_q, a∈𝔽_q^×, and b∈𝔽_q, one has max{|A+A|,|AA|}≥C|A|^{5/4}?
decisive_failure: The investigation established concrete barriers (incidence arithmetic and a hardness reduction to the open prime-field 5/4 bound) plus a bounded small-field sanity check, but it did not prove or disprove the target. The computational search covered only F_25 and F_49 at small set sizes and cannot address uniformity over all extension fields. No independently valuable alternative result was found.
